name: 潮霧の輪・低く広がる霧環
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE original registered transparent game VFX master for Color Resonance's learned summon-route spell 潮霧の輪 (gran_spray). Use the supplied actual game references for a shared cool turquoise / sapphire / pearl-white color identity and clean illustrated cel finish. Reference 1 is the broad crashing wave: keep only its water palette, not its curling wave, splash or droplets. Reference 2 is the healing bowl: keep only its simple broad water shading, not its bowl or separate drops. Reference 3 is Gran the ocean spirit: keep only his calm clear blue identity, no whale, city or body. This spell is a quiet LOW RING OF SEA MIST that spreads around a selected tactical ground cell and affects nearby enemies; it is not a healing bowl, shield, weapon slash, flood or large wall of water.
Output1536 x1024 true-transparent RGBA. Exactly one connected hollow horizontal ellipse of condensed turquoise sea mist, viewed from a slightly elevated isometric angle, centered at(768,512). Overall width about1100px, total height about430px; interior ellipse is completely clear, about760px wide and220px high. The band is robust and substantial, with soft rounded cloud-volume lobes that merge smoothly into ONE continuous contour around the whole ellipse. About3 broad gently uneven cloud bulges on the back edge and3 on the front edge; no small scallops or repeating fine waves. Front band lower in the image has slightly darker moderate teal under-edge for bright-floor contrast, pale aqua body, and ONE broad pearl-white lit area. Back band is quieter sapphire/aqua. Only3–4 broad clean cel shading zones; high opaque inner body with minimal clean edge antialiasing. Keep the hollow center alpha-zero and show no ground through painted pixels. Leave at least170px fully transparent margin on every side. Readable after reduction to about184px wide. No diffuse outside fog cloud, no external bloom haze, no detached droplets/specks or hairline outlines. This is one low rounded mist annulus, not thin mathematical circle strokes, concentric rings or a vertical shield. The dark teal contour is colored water, not a black silhouette.
No character, hair, face, hand, enemy, whale, literal sword, wound, black erasure, cloud of punishment, city, boat, landscape, floor painting, rainbow floor, platform, ground shadow, healing symbol, cross, spark, star, particle, bubble, shard, crystal facet, scales, filigree, fine foam dots, letters, text, rune, glyph, checkerboard, border, background or watermark. Exactly the single connected low oval mist ring, with a transparent hollow center and transparent surroundings.
髪は全て透過せず、下位レイヤーを描写しない
髪の不透明度は100％とする
intricate textures（複雑な質感）の要素は抑えめにし、過剰な微細描写、エッジノイズ、粒状のきらめき、鱗状の模様、等間隔に繰り返す細かな波打ちを避け、全体になめらかで清潔感のある質感を強調してください。
